question: The Veda Samaj was established in ____.
solution:
The correct answer is __Madras__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Veda Samaj__

 
 
• Veda Samaj was established by the efforts of Keshab Chandra Sen and K. Sridharalu Naidu in 1864 at Madras.
 
• The Veda Samaj was inspired by the Brahmo Samaj.
 
• It worked to abolish caste distinctions and promote widow remarriage and women’s education.
 
• Its members believed in one God.
 
• They condemned the superstitions and rituals of orthodox Hinduism.
